publications.title: From Woofs to Words: Towards Intelligent Robotic Guide Dogs with Verbal Communication
publications.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
publications.verified_technical_summary: Combined LLM dialogue, symbolic task planning, and plan/scene verbalization for a robotic guide dog. Evaluated task specification on 77 simulated service requests; the multi-turn system achieved 94.8% accuracy. Evaluated verbalization with visually impaired participants using a Unitree Go2 under operator-controlled motion.
claim_limits: 94.8% is simulated dialogue task-specification accuracy, not autonomous real-world navigation success.
The human study used Wizard-of-Oz control; do not describe it as autonomous navigation trials.
Paper-level methods and results establish collaborative research, not sole personal ownership of every implementation component.

publications.title: Vision language models can parse floor plan maps
publications.verified_technical_summary: Evaluated GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet on floor-plan parsing and generation of navigation action sequences. Analyzed map size, task complexity, and label density, with up to 96% success on a reported nine-action navigation task setting; demonstrated the pipeline on a quadruped robot.
claim_limits: The 96% result is a particular experimental setting, not aggregate success across all maps.
This publisher identifies the venue as a journal, not a conference.

publications.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Detecting Antisemitism
publications.venue: Proceedings of the 2025 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
publications.verified_technical_summary: Evaluated eight open-source LLMs on policy-guided antisemitism detection using 11,315 annotated posts. Compared prompting and decoding strategies, introduced Guided-CoT, and measured semantic differences between generated explanations. Self-consistency used 30 inference samples per post; Guided-CoT improved positive-class F1 by 0.03-0.13 over zero-shot CoT in the reported comparisons.
claim_limits: Dataset was existing human-annotated data, not created entirely by this paper.
Do not claim model pretraining, fine-tuning, kernel development, or sole authorship of the evaluation framework from this paper alone.
